tagline: Leading global provider of data center, colocation and interconnection solutions
hero_kpi_rationale: The data center portfolio is the primary growth driver for the company, with a global presence across 310 facilities offering comprehensive colocation and interconnection solutions.
company_description: Digital Realty Trust, Inc. owns, acquires, develops, and operates data centers through its operating partnership subsidiary, Digital Realty Trust, L.P. The company is focused on providing data center, colocation, and interconnection solutions for domestic and international customers across a variety of industry verticals ranging from cloud and information technology services, communications and social networking to financial services, manufacturing, energy, healthcare, and consumer products. As of March 31, 2026, the company's 309 data centers, including 89 data centers held as investments in unconsolidated entities, contain applications and operations critical to the day-to-day operations of technology industry and corporate enterprise data center customers. Digital Realty's portfolio is comprised of approximately 3.0 gigawatts of IT capacity, as well as approximately 6.3 gigawatts of buildable IT capacity under active development and held for future development, located throughout North America, Europe, South America, Asia, Australia, and Africa. Digital Realty Trust, Inc. was established on March 09, 2004 and is based in Dallas, United States.

risks.title: Inflation-related risks
risks.summary: Inflation can affect operating costs, leasing demand, and real estate asset values.
risks.score_rationale: The risk is explicitly mentioned in Item 1A as potentially impacting the business directly or indirectly. The language is presented as significant, although without detailed elaboration. It is a major macroeconomic risk for a USD-listed real estate asset. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Real estate asset impairment
risks.summary: If future cash flows from a property do not cover its carrying value, an impairment loss must be recognized.
risks.score_rationale: While the provided text does not detail specific 2025 impairments, it notes that fair value estimates and recoverability assessments of real estate and intangible assets are critical accounting policies involving significant judgment and subjectivity. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Fair value estimation
risks.summary: Fair value estimates are subjective and may differ from actual market amounts realized.
risks.score_rationale: Fair value is used for acquisitions, dispositions, and impairments. The text emphasizes the significant degree of judgment and subjectivity involved, which could materially impact financial results. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Foreign exchange risks internationally
risks.summary: Fluctuations in foreign currencies can affect international revenues and asset values (113 data centers in Europe, 36 in Latin America, 16 in Africa, 18 in Asia, 6 in Australia).
risks.score_rationale: Multiple currencies are involved (EUR, GBP, JPY, ZAR, BRL, etc.). The portfolio includes 189 international data centers (61% of total) out of 310. Risk is mitigated by swaps and local financing, but remains present. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Concentration on rental revenues
risks.summary: Revenue reliability depends heavily on tenant solvency and rent collection, with an average lease renewal period of 5 years.
risks.score_rationale: The majority of revenues come from leases with data center customers. The text specifies that revenue recognition depends on the probable collectability of rents, which could impact results in case of tenant default. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Integration of acquisitions and co-investments
risks.summary: Integrating acquired assets and managing joint ventures present operational risks and risks to achieving anticipated synergies.
risks.score_rationale: Digital Realty completed several major acquisitions and co-investments in 2025 (Blackstone joint venture, BDIA Indonesia, DC Partners NA Fund), creating operational integration risks and risks to achieving expected returns. (default score, to be refined)

ai_positioning.summary: Digital Realty identifies artificial intelligence as one of the drivers of digital transformation and growing demand for computing capacity, recognized as a key technological advancement affecting data center growth.
evidence: The Internet of Things, 5G, autonomous vehicles and artificial intelligence, among other technological advancements, are driving this digital transformation.
